newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi trade team to go to London for talks on oil contracts.
- Israeli prime minister holds security meeting to discuss ways of protecting (Palestinian) land dealers.
- Saudi Basic Industries Corp signs a contract with Mitsubishi Heavy Industries of Japan to build a fourth methanol plant in Saudi Arabia.
- Egypt begins first power grid linkage in the Middle East.
- Street clashes in Freetown halt evacuation of stranded Lebanese.
- Iraq starts negotiations with China to develop oil field at cost of $500 million.
- Jordan's al-Yarmouk insurance company raises capital to $2.8 million.
